svg.aria-label: A caller reaches the phone network or a SIP trunk, and the call audio streams at 8 kHz over a WebSocket to a voice agent that uses speech-to-text, an LLM and text-to-speech with business tools. Calls are either resolved or warmly transferred to a human with a summary, so the caller does not repeat themselves. Media is kept in an Indian region, with recording consent and do-not-disturb rules respected.
svg.text: 8 kHz audio over a WebSocket to the voice agent

g.text: STT → LLM → TTS, tools: order, refund, KYC status

svg.text: Media in an Indian region; recording consent; DND rules

g.text: human agent sees the summary: caller does not repeat
